# diBoaS

> Goal-driven wealth building. Pre-launch: a waitlist, a play-money Practice app, free money tools and a money-basics series. No real-money features are live.

diBoaS is building a goal-driven way to give money a job. Today, diboas.com offers a waitlist, the Money Tools calculators and the Real Talk learning series; the Practice app at app.diboas.com uses play money only.

## Available today

- Practice app with play money only (app.diboas.com)
- Money Tools: 11 free calculators
- Real Talk: a 7-talk money-basics series
- A waitlist for the full product

## Pages

- [Home](https://diboas.com/en): Main landing page with waitlist
- [About](https://diboas.com/en/about): Founder story and mission
- [Strategies](https://diboas.com/en/strategies): How each strategy works — goals, timelines and risk
- [Protocols](https://diboas.com/en/protocols): The protocols diBoaS has researched, and the ones its strategies use
- [Money Tools](https://diboas.com/en/tools): Free calculators
- [Learn](https://diboas.com/en/learn): The Real Talk series
- [Help](https://diboas.com/en/help): FAQ and support
- [Security](https://diboas.com/en/security): Security information

## Languages

Available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, and German.
